    <h1 style="font-family: Fraunces; margin: 0 0 0 0;">Ryan Duffy</h1>
    <p style="text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; font-size: 0.85rem; color: #555; margin-top: 0.25rem;">
    Co-Principal Investigator
    </p>
    <p>Ryan D. Duffy, Ph.D., is Professor of Psychology at the University of Florida and Program Director of the Counseling Psychology Program at the University of Florida.</p>
    <p>The author of over 150 peer-reviewed journal articles, Ryan’s research is primarily in the areas of vocational psychology and positive psychology. Topics he has studied include calling, job satisfaction, well-being, work volition, work values, and the interface of spirituality and work.</p>
    <p>He is currently the Editor-in Chief of the Journal of Vocational Behavior, which publishes original empirical and theoretical articles that contribute novel insights to the fields of career choice, career development, and work adjustment. Ryan is also the co-author of <i>Make Your Job a Calling: How the Psychology of Vocation Can Change Your Life at Work</i> (Templeton Press, 2012).</p>
